capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Sierra EV Extended Range pack 170 kWh; Weekly Driver 20-module Ultium truck pack 170 kWh as published (no usable/gross split).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: GM Ultium cells shared with the Silverado EV; closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Silverado EV Extended Range (same 20-module pack): 670 V, 800 V class, up to 300 kW (GM spec guide); Wikipedia: Sierra EV 400 V switching to 800 V when charging.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: GM's battery-preconditioning guide (chevrolet.com returns 403, search excerpt only): automatic with Google built-in navigation plus a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app; applied lineup-wide to GM Ultium vehicles as for Silverado EV/Equinox EV records. UNVERIFIED on a page for this model.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Same 20-module pack as the Silverado EV Extended Range: up to 300 kW (GM spec guide).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port Sierra EV page: home charging is 11.5 kW on Elevation, Denali and AT4 Extended Range; 19.2 kW applies only to the Max Range (Denali Max, 205 kWh). Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW as the model maximum, not for this pack.
